actions.title: Download CER File
actions.tooltip: Download the signed certificate (link expires in 1 hour)

_comment_posting: This card is posted proactively to the requester's Teams channel when the workflow reaches state COMPLETE. It is also posted (with appropriate final_state_label) for REJECTED and FAILED terminal states so the requester is always notified of the outcome.
_comment_sas_ttl: cer_blob_sas_url is a short-TTL (1 hour) SAS URL generated at card-post time. It provides scoped, time-limited read access to the immutable CER file in Blob storage. Do not store or share beyond this window.
_comment_accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA: final state is conveyed by both text label AND color (color is not the sole signal); all Action.OpenUrl have tooltip text; tab order is top-to-bottom.

_comment_template_vars.final_state_label: string — 'Renewal Complete' | 'Renewal Rejected' | 'Renewal Failed — Manual Action Required'
_comment_template_vars.final_state_color: string — 'Good' for COMPLETE, 'Warning' for FAILED, 'Attention' for REJECTED (Adaptive Card semantic colors; text label also present)
_comment_template_vars.chg_number: string — ServiceNow CHG number, e.g. CHG0012345 (empty string if not yet created)
_comment_template_vars.pki_email_thread_url: string — Outlook Web URL for the email thread
_comment_template_vars.cer_blob_sas_url: string — short-TTL SAS URL for CER blob download
